description: This file contains implementation of tensor operations specifically optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend, including functions for permuting tensor dimensions, repeating tensors, and interleaving repeats, within the ATen (PyTorch) library.

methods.name: permute_mps
methods.description: Permutes the dimensions of a tensor according to specified order, optimized for MPS backend.

methods.name: repeat_mps
methods.description: Repeats a tensor along specified dimensions, supporting expansion and utilizing MPS graph caching.

methods.name: repeat_interleave_mps
methods.description: Performs repeat-interleave operation on a 1D tensor, accelerated with MPS.
